planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno and pins are preserved: LM35 on A1, fan PWM on D5, TM1637 CLK=D4 & DIO=D2, buzzer on D6.
Fan speed tier thresholds (LM35 temperature breakpoints) and the exact mapping from tier to TM1637 numeric value are business/model logic; not provided in wiring facts.
Fan PWM duty values for each tier (off/low/mid/high) are business/model logic; initial PWM is set to 0.
Buzzer behavior is modeled as tone_output updates with SysML controlling when/for how long; only pin capability is declared here.
TM1637 startup display value is set to 0 (assumed corresponds to OFF tier); adjust in SysML if OFF tier should display a different number.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Fan PWM command (0=off, higher=multi-speed duty driven by model)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer tone for short鸣提示 when entering high-speed

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Display current fan speed tier (OFF/LOW/MID/HIGH encoded to model-selected number)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个多级风扇控制系统，使用 LM35（A1）、风扇 PWM D5、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和蜂鸣器 D6。根据温度把风扇分为关闭、低速、中速、高速四档，数码管显示当前档位；进入高速档时蜂鸣器短鸣提示。
